icons.title: Token
icons.meaning: One discrete piece of text the model can process.

icons.title: Token stream
icons.meaning: An ordered sequence of token pieces flowing through a model.

icons.title: Prompt
icons.meaning: Instructions and context supplied to a model.

icons.title: Query
icons.meaning: A learned request vector that compares with keys to find relevant context.

icons.title: Key
icons.meaning: A vector that describes what information a token offers.

icons.title: Value
icons.meaning: A value vector whose information is combined in proportion to its attention weight.

icons.title: Attention
icons.meaning: A token combines information from other tokens using learned weights.

icons.title: Router
icons.meaning: A learned gate assigns incoming work to selected paths.

icons.title: Expert
icons.meaning: A feed-forward network inside a routed transformer layer.

icons.title: Mixture of experts
icons.meaning: A router sends each token through a selected subset of expert networks.

icons.title: Cache
icons.meaning: Reusable intermediate data kept close to computation.

icons.title: Cache block
icons.meaning: A page of token state with a valid region and an allocation boundary.

icons.title: Gradient
icons.meaning: A direction and rate of change that guide parameter updates.

icons.title: Loss
icons.meaning: A score that measures how far a model prediction is from its target.

icons.title: Weights
icons.meaning: Learned numerical parameters that shape a model's behavior.

icons.title: Matrix
icons.meaning: A rectangular array of numbers transformed by model layers.

icons.title: Adapter
icons.meaning: A small trainable module added to a larger pretrained model.

icons.title: LoRA
icons.meaning: Low-rank factors that add a trainable update to frozen weights.

icons.title: Quantization
icons.meaning: Mapping high-precision values onto a smaller set of representable levels.

icons.title: Bit packing
icons.meaning: Storing low-bit values together in compact machine words.

icons.title: Reward
icons.meaning: A training signal that scores a candidate response.

icons.title: Preference
icons.meaning: A comparison that records which of two responses a person favors.

icons.title: Embedding
icons.meaning: A learned vector that places an item in a space of relationships.

icons.title: Position
icons.meaning: An item's location in an ordered token sequence.

icons.title: Rotation
icons.meaning: A phase rotation that encodes relative position in paired dimensions.

icons.title: Noise
icons.meaning: A random signal mixed into data during diffusion training or generation.

icons.title: Denoiser
icons.meaning: A neural network that predicts how to remove noise at a given step.

icons.title: Sampler
icons.meaning: A numerical procedure that follows a learned distribution to generate a sample.

icons.title: Diffusion
icons.meaning: A sequence of denoising steps that turns noise into an image in pixel or latent space.

icons.title: Model
icons.meaning: A learned network that maps input signals to useful outputs.

icons.title: GPU
icons.meaning: A processor built to run many numerical operations in parallel.

icons.title: Batch
icons.meaning: A group of inputs scheduled for shared processing.

icons.title: A/B experiment assignment and inference
icons.meaning: Randomly assigns units to control and treatment, estimates an outcome difference, and quantifies uncertainty.

icons.title: Activation functions
icons.meaning: Adds a nonlinear transformation between affine neural-network layers.

icons.title: Autoregressive generation loop
icons.meaning: Produces a sequence by selecting one next token conditioned on the prompt and prior generated tokens.

icons.title: Backpropagation graph
icons.meaning: Moves derivatives backward through a computation graph and adds contributions where paths meet.

icons.title: Bayesian update
icons.meaning: Combines a prior distribution with observed-data likelihood to form a posterior distribution.

icons.title: Causal graph patterns
icons.meaning: Uses directed graphs to encode assumptions about causal relationships and adjustment.

icons.title: Chat template and training data flow
icons.meaning: Serializes conversational records into token streams and assigns loss to selected positions.

icons.title: Classification confusion matrix
icons.meaning: Counts predicted labels against true labels so each error type remains visible.

icons.title: Compute-optimal training allocation
icons.meaning: Shows how a fixed compute budget can be allocated across model size, data, and later inference costs.

icons.title: Conformal prediction and coverage
icons.meaning: Calibrates a prediction set or interval using held-out nonconformity scores and a finite-sample rank.

icons.title: Convolution and receptive field
icons.meaning: Applies a shared local filter across image positions and combines channels into feature maps.

icons.title: Decision-tree split
icons.meaning: Partitions feature space through sequential tests and assigns a prediction to each leaf.

icons.title: Distributed collective operations
icons.meaning: Coordinates tensor movement or reduction across participating ranks.

icons.title: Model drift and delayed labels
icons.meaning: Separates input distribution changes from performance evidence that arrives after outcomes mature.

icons.title: Embedding neighborhood map
icons.meaning: Shows how a similarity metric ranks nearby vectors in a learned representation space.

icons.title: Floating-point formats
icons.meaning: Represents signed values with finite exponent range and finite precision determined by a bit layout.

icons.title: Tiled matrix multiplication
icons.meaning: Reuses input tiles in fast local memory to reduce global-memory traffic during matrix multiplication.

icons.title: GPU execution hierarchy
icons.meaning: Maps host launches and memory ownership to GPU grids, blocks, threads, warps, and multiprocessors.

icons.title: Gradient descent landscape
icons.meaning: Shows how a parameter update follows a local gradient on an objective surface.

icons.title: Learning-rate schedule
icons.meaning: Changes the optimizer step scale according to training progress.

icons.title: Dynamic loss scaling controller
icons.meaning: Scales a training loss to keep small gradients representable, then detects overflow before the optimizer update.

icons.title: Model parallelism topologies
icons.meaning: Splits model computation or state across devices along different dimensions.

icons.title: Optimizer state and moments
icons.meaning: Maintains gradient history and coordinate scale to compute parameter updates.

icons.title: Preference-training pipeline
icons.meaning: Turns comparisons between responses into a reward model or a direct preference-optimization objective.

icons.title: Recurrent and gated state
icons.meaning: Carries a learned state through an ordered sequence, with LSTM/GRU gates controlling updates.

icons.title: Policy and environment loop
icons.meaning: Improves a policy through repeated state, action, outcome, and reward feedback.

icons.title: Retrieval fusion and reranking
icons.meaning: Combines candidate lists from complementary retrieval methods, then spends more compute on a shortlist.

icons.title: Reward-model exploitation loop
icons.meaning: Shows how optimizing a proxy reward can amplify behaviors that score well while missing the intended human objective.

icons.title: Roofline performance model
icons.meaning: Bounds kernel throughput by peak compute and memory bandwidth at a given arithmetic intensity.

icons.title: Sampling distributions and bootstrap
icons.meaning: Uses repeated samples to show how an estimator varies under finite data and dependence assumptions.

icons.title: Softmax distribution
icons.meaning: Turns a row of raw scores into normalized probability mass over competing choices.

icons.title: Sparse autoencoder feature view
icons.meaning: Maps activations into a wider sparse feature space and reconstructs the original activation.

icons.title: Synthetic data admission loop
icons.meaning: Generates candidate training examples and filters them against quality, execution, safety, and diversity checks.

icons.title: Task-vector model merging
icons.meaning: Represents a fine-tune as a parameter difference from a shared base and combines such deltas.

icons.title: Teacher-student distillation
icons.meaning: Trains a smaller student to match information from a larger teacher through soft targets, features, or generated responses.

icons.title: Temporal feature availability
icons.meaning: Checks that each training/evaluation feature was available at the prediction decision time.

icons.title: Classification threshold sweep
icons.meaning: Shows how a decision threshold changes classifications and precision/recall trade-offs.

icons.title: Subword tokenization algorithms
icons.meaning: Segments text into token IDs under a fixed vocabulary and tokenizer-specific rules.

icons.title: Training step state machine
icons.meaning: Orders gradient reset, forward computation, loss evaluation, backward propagation, and optimizer update.

icons.title: Variational autoencoder path
icons.meaning: Encodes an input as a latent distribution, samples a code, and trains a decoder under reconstruction and prior-matching terms.

icons.title: Document chunk
icons.meaning: A retrieval unit that keeps searchable text attached to its source location and parent structure.

icons.title: Citation span
icons.meaning: A traceable link from a specific answer claim to the source text and version that support it.

icons.title: Retrieval access filter
icons.meaning: A trusted predicate that limits retrieval candidates by caller, tenant, version, or other product rules before evidence reaches later stages.

icons.title: Hybrid search lanes
icons.meaning: Parallel lexical and dense retrieval paths whose ranked candidates are fused into one eligible result set.

icons.title: HNSW graph search
icons.meaning: Approximate nearest-neighbor search that navigates a layered proximity graph and retains a bounded candidate set.

icons.title: IVF centroid probing
icons.meaning: An approximate search that assigns vectors to centroid lists and scans only a chosen number of nearest lists.

icons.title: Cross-encoder reranker
icons.meaning: A second-stage model that jointly scores query and candidate text to improve ordering within an already retrieved shortlist.

icons.title: Query rewrite
icons.meaning: A transformation of a user's search wording into one or more retrieval keys that preserve the original request and its constraints.

icons.title: Graph evidence path
icons.meaning: A multi-hop chain through source-linked entities and relationships that supplies a broader evidence set for a query.

icons.title: Evidence packet
icons.meaning: A compact, ordered set of retrieved passages with enough source, version, permission, and location data to support a response.

icons.title: Tool call envelope
icons.meaning: A structured operation proposed by a model and executed only by a host that validates and authorizes its name and arguments.

icons.title: Runtime policy gate
icons.meaning: A trusted decision point that checks caller identity, action, arguments, resource scope, and required approval before a side effect.

icons.title: Workflow DAG
icons.meaning: A directed workflow in which independent tasks can fan out, validated results join, and external effects have explicit owners.

icons.title: Typed workflow state
icons.meaning: A shared, versioned record whose fields and identities let workflow nodes exchange validated evidence without relying on free-form summaries.

icons.title: Workflow checkpoint
icons.meaning: A durable snapshot of execution position and pending-operation identity used to resume after interruption and reconcile external effects.

icons.title: Approval-bound action
icons.meaning: A human decision bound to the exact proposed effect, policy, target revision, and validity window.

icons.title: Agent sandbox boundary
icons.meaning: An operating-system-enforced boundary that limits an agent's filesystem, process, network, credentials, and runtime resources.

icons.title: Secret broker
icons.meaning: A host-controlled service that performs a narrowly scoped authenticated request for an untrusted worker without exposing its credential.

icons.title: Circuit breaker
icons.meaning: A dependency guard that admits calls while healthy, fails fast while open, and allows a limited recovery probe.

icons.title: Retry with backoff and jitter
icons.meaning: A bounded retry schedule that spreads attempts over time while preserving one operation identity and an absolute deadline.

icons.title: Provider fallback route
icons.meaning: A route selector that first removes lanes violating hard requirements, then ranks compatible providers and revalidates fallback output.

icons.title: Bounded request queue
icons.meaning: A finite waiting area for admitted work with visible age, deadline, and caller ownership.

icons.title: Backpressure
icons.meaning: A capacity signal that slows, pauses, or rejects new work while downstream workers drain admitted work.

icons.title: Continuous batching
icons.meaning: A serving schedule that admits new sequences into freed decode slots between generation steps.

icons.title: Autoscaling control loop
icons.meaning: A controller that converts measured demand into desired replicas and admits only capacity that is scheduled, loaded, and healthy.

icons.title: Warm GPU capacity
icons.meaning: The staged path from scheduled hardware through model load and warmup to replicas that can safely receive traffic.

icons.title: Request latency waterfall
icons.meaning: A timeline that places each request stage on one declared clock and distinguishes serial work from overlapped work.

icons.title: Request trace
icons.meaning: A parent request span connected to retrieval, model, tool, safety, and response spans with timestamps and stable identities.

icons.title: Canary rollout
icons.meaning: A time-limited, partial exposure of a new release with predeclared metrics and stop rules before wider promotion.

icons.title: Traffic split
icons.meaning: A weighted routing rule that sends eligible requests to different live destinations while preserving assignment identity.

icons.title: Semantic cache eligibility
icons.meaning: A reuse layer that returns a prior answer only after access, release, freshness, and similarity requirements all hold.

icons.title: Adapter residency
icons.meaning: A capacity hierarchy that moves task adapters among GPU, CPU, and storage tiers while a shared base model stays loaded.

icons.title: Release manifest
icons.meaning: A versioned identity that binds model bytes to the tokenizer, prompt, retrieval, policy, serving, and evaluation inputs that produced a live behavior.

icons.title: SLO and error budget
icons.meaning: A measurement window and explicit good-event rule that determine how much service behavior may miss a user-facing target.

icons.title: Evaluation gate
icons.meaning: A versioned pass/fail checkpoint that combines policy constraints, quality evidence, and release ownership before exposure expands.

icons.title: Human review queue
icons.meaning: A work queue that presents bounded, attributable decisions to reviewers while preserving hard policy gates and escalation rules.

icons.title: Differential privacy adjacency
icons.meaning: A visual comparison of datasets that differ by one stated protected unit and the bounded output distributions a randomized mechanism should produce.

icons.title: Voice turn and playback state
icons.meaning: The live voice-session state that distinguishes detected speech, committed turns, generated audio, confirmed playback, and interruption.

icons.title: Evaluation row
icons.meaning: One replayable graded case joining fixed inputs, observed behavior, grader evidence, and version pins.

icons.title: Benchmark protocol
icons.meaning: Versioned rules for task population, scoring, budget, and valid comparison.

icons.title: Dataset split
icons.meaning: Policy assigning examples to train, validation, and untouched test roles.

icons.title: Data lineage
icons.meaning: Directed record linking sources, transformations, versions, owners, and artifacts.

icons.title: Confidence interval
icons.meaning: Range computed by a stated procedure to quantify sampling uncertainty.

icons.title: Probability calibration
icons.meaning: Agreement between stated probabilities and observed frequencies.

icons.title: Risk-coverage curve
icons.meaning: Error among accepted cases as the system accepts a larger or smaller share.

icons.title: Ranking metrics
icons.meaning: Distinct summaries of retrieval relevance, rank position, and recall.

icons.title: Judge agreement
icons.meaning: Agreement between automated evaluators and human labels under one rubric.

icons.title: Causal effect
icons.meaning: Outcome contrast under two interventions for a defined population and estimand.

icons.title: Sequential test
icons.meaning: Experiment analysis accounting for repeated looks at accumulating data.

icons.title: Statistical power
icons.meaning: Probability a test detects a specified effect under a stated alternative and design.

icons.title: Release gate
icons.meaning: Predeclared decision rule required before an artifact or system advances.

icons.title: Audit receipt
icons.meaning: Evidence of actor, identity, policy, evidence, versions, and outcome.

icons.title: Permission filter
icons.meaning: Policy check limiting retrieved candidates to caller-authorized scope.

icons.title: Trust boundary
icons.meaning: Crossing between components with different authority, identity, or data trust.

icons.title: Sandbox
icons.meaning: Constrained execution limiting resources, filesystem/network access, and authority.

icons.title: Secret redaction
icons.meaning: Detection and replacement/removal of credentials before exposure or storage.

icons.title: Structured tool call
icons.meaning: Typed request with schema-validated arguments and separately checked result.

icons.title: Workflow state machine
icons.meaning: Named states and guarded transitions constraining progress and recovery.

icons.title: Bounded queue
icons.meaning: Finite-capacity queue with explicit backpressure under overload.

icons.title: Token bucket
icons.meaning: Rate limiter with capped balance replenished over time and spent on admission.

icons.title: Fallback route
icons.meaning: Policy-controlled alternate destination used when preferred route is unavailable or ineligible.

icons.title: Idempotency fence
icons.meaning: Stable key or lease token preventing duplicate effects from retries or stale workers.

icons.title: Prefix trie
icons.meaning: Tree sharing common prefixes for lookup and reuse.

icons.title: Retrieval pipeline
icons.meaning: Stages from candidate generation through filtering, ranking, packing, and evidence use.

icons.title: GPU memory ledger
icons.meaning: Accounting of weights, activations, optimizer, cache, workspaces, and reserve.

icons.title: Collective routing
icons.meaning: Rank-to-rank movement satisfying distributed ownership contracts.

icons.title: Kernel tiling
icons.meaning: Processing large tensors in bounded tiles with near-compute staging and reuse.

icons.title: Latency and service metrics
icons.meaning: Measurements separating first-token time, inter-token delay, throughput, and useful work.

icons.title: Tensor axes
icons.meaning: Coordinate axes and a tensor slice reveal how dimensions extend beyond a flat matrix.

icons.title: Singular directions
icons.meaning: Orthogonal directions show which input variations survive a linear transformation most strongly.

icons.title: Regression residual
icons.meaning: A residual is the vertical gap between an observed value and its fitted prediction at the same input.

icons.title: Sigmoid threshold
icons.meaning: A probability threshold converts a logistic model score into a class decision.

icons.title: Classification boundary
icons.meaning: A decision boundary separates regions where a classifier predicts different classes.

icons.title: Cross-validation folds
icons.meaning: Held-out folds rotate so each partition measures generalization while the others train the model.

icons.title: Causal intervention
icons.meaning: An intervention sets a treatment value and removes its usual incoming causes from the causal graph.

icons.title: Neuron signal
icons.meaning: A neuron combines weighted inputs, applies an activation function, and sends an output signal.

icons.title: Probability mass
icons.meaning: A discrete distribution assigns probability mass to outcomes, with the masses summing to one.

icons.title: Optimizer trajectory
icons.meaning: Momentum combines a gradient with running velocity that carries updates through a curved loss surface.

icons.title: Conformal quantile
icons.meaning: A calibration quantile sets a prediction interval whose empirical coverage can be checked on held-out examples.

icons.title: Transformer block
icons.meaning: A transformer block combines attention and a feed-forward layer with residual paths.

icons.title: Next-token logits
icons.meaning: Logits score candidate next tokens before softmax converts them into probabilities.

icons.title: Contrastive pair
icons.meaning: Contrastive learning pulls matching examples together in embedding space and separates mismatched examples.

icons.title: Scaling frontier
icons.meaning: A scaling frontier compares achievable model quality with compute and exposes diminishing returns.

icons.title: Assistant loss mask
icons.meaning: Supervised fine-tuning can score assistant targets while keeping user prompts as conditioning context.

icons.title: Online softmax
icons.meaning: Online softmax updates a running maximum and normalizer as attention scores arrive tile by tile.

icons.title: Speculative draft and verify
icons.meaning: A draft model proposes several tokens that a larger model verifies in one parallel pass.

icons.title: Schema automaton
icons.meaning: A schema automaton tracks valid output states and blocks tokens that cannot lead to a valid structure.

icons.title: Causal attention mask
icons.meaning: A causal mask lets each position attend to itself and earlier positions while blocking future tokens.

icons.title: Training-data mixture
icons.meaning: A training mixture assigns sampling weights to datasets before examples enter the training stream.

icons.title: Sequence packing
icons.meaning: Packing short training sequences into one block reduces padding while keeping boundaries visible.

icons.title: FlashAttention tile dataflow
icons.meaning: FlashAttention reuses query, key, and value tiles in fast memory to reduce high-bandwidth memory traffic.

icons.title: Tensor shard
icons.meaning: Tensor parallelism partitions a weight matrix across devices and combines partial results at communication boundaries.

icons.title: Preference vote
icons.meaning: A labeler's comparison identifies which of two complete answers better meets the same request.

icons.title: Verifiable answer
icons.meaning: An independent checker tests an answer against a defined outcome contract and emits evidence.

icons.title: Document page
icons.meaning: A source page whose extracted text keeps its locator and provenance.

icons.title: Authorization gate
icons.meaning: A trusted permission check admits only records the authenticated principal may read.

icons.title: Instruction boundary
icons.meaning: A model application distinguishes trusted instructions from untrusted evidence while enforcing authority in code.

icons.title: Approval receipt
icons.meaning: A recorded human decision is bound to one exact action, version, and set of preconditions.

icons.title: Warp reduction
icons.meaning: GPU lanes combine partial values through synchronized parallel steps.

icons.title: KV cache handoff
icons.meaning: A serving system transfers prompt-derived key and value state to the worker that will generate tokens.

icons.title: Judge rubric
icons.meaning: Two candidate answers are evaluated against the same explicit criteria and reviewed labels.

icons.title: Voice turn
icons.meaning: Incoming speech interrupts outgoing audio and updates which part of a response was heard.

icons.title: Continued training stream
icons.meaning: A pretrained model adapts to new domain text while replay examples can preserve selected general-language behavior.

icons.title: Sharded training state
icons.meaning: Parameters, gradients, and optimizer states are partitioned across training devices and gathered as computation needs them.

icons.title: Model weight merge
icons.meaning: Compatible model parameter tensors contribute to one merged checkpoint that must be evaluated.

icons.title: Clipped private gradient
icons.meaning: Per-example gradient contributions are bounded before aggregation and calibrated Gaussian noise is added.

icons.title: Synthetic data filter
icons.meaning: Generated examples pass quality, correctness, duplication, and diversity checks before training admission.

icons.title: Principle-guided critique
icons.meaning: A written principle guides a model's critique and revision of its draft before the revised answer becomes a supervised target.

icons.title: Memory retention valve
icons.meaning: Gates control how stored recurrent evidence survives and how a candidate enters the state.

icons.title: Latent posterior cloud
icons.meaning: An encoder describes a distribution of possible latent codes for an observed input.

icons.title: Dataset lineage gates
icons.meaning: A source record passes through schema, identity, and group checks before a versioned dataset is released.

icons.title: Feature contract vector
icons.meaning: Named measurements pass through type and availability checks into fixed ordered model coordinates.

icons.title: Estimation interval
icons.meaning: Repeated sample estimates gather around a central estimate inside an uncertainty interval.

icons.title: Paired outcomes
icons.meaning: Two systems are evaluated on matched tasks so ties and directional changes remain visible.

icons.title: Streaming feature watermark
icons.meaning: A streaming feature advances through event time while late arrivals remain distinguishable from on-time state.

icons.title: Recommendation candidate slate
icons.meaning: Eligible candidates are retrieved, scored, and assembled into an ordered recommendation slate.

icons.title: Forecast residual band
icons.meaning: A forecast center and uncertainty band are compared with observed values and their residuals.

icons.title: Model monitoring drift
icons.meaning: Reference and current feature distributions are compared as a monitored shift is surfaced for review.

icons.title: Serving benchmark latency
icons.meaning: A measured serving trace separates median latency from the slower tail over a defined load interval.

icons.title: Token economics meter
icons.meaning: Input, cached context, and generated output have separate token usage and cost weights.

icons.title: Generalization curve
icons.meaning: Training error falls with capacity while held-out error can rise as a model fits sample-specific noise.

icons.title: Randomized treatment
icons.meaning: Random assignment makes the treatment and control groups comparable in expectation.

icons.title: Reward feedback loop
icons.meaning: An agent observes a state, acts, receives a reward, and continues from the resulting state.

icons.title: Principal axis
icons.meaning: A principal component points along a direction of greatest centered data variance.

icons.title: Latent responsibilities
icons.meaning: Expectation-maximization assigns each observation fractional membership in mixture components.

icons.title: Broadcast axis
icons.meaning: Broadcasting reuses dimensions whose size is one across compatible array axes.

icons.title: Selective affine scan
icons.meaning: Input-dependent affine updates compose in order to recover every prefix state.

icons.title: Patch to token
icons.meaning: A spatial pixel patch becomes a projected vector while its location remains separately represented.

icons.title: Feature centering
icons.meaning: Per-token normalization centers and rescales feature coordinates before learned affine adjustments.

icons.title: Sparse feature dictionary
icons.meaning: A sparse code reconstructs a mixed model activation using a few learned dictionary directions.

icons.title: Reasoning budget tree
icons.meaning: Inference budget can fund longer reasoning, more candidates, and verification before selecting an answer.

icons.title: Token surprisal
icons.meaning: A model assigns log loss to observed tokens and perplexity exponentiates their average surprise.

icons.title: Beam search tree
icons.meaning: Two candidate paths remain bright while lower-scoring branches are pruned.

icons.title: Inverted index
icons.meaning: Term keys connect to ordered posting-list entries for matching documents.

icons.title: Data structure choices
icons.meaning: A sequential list, indexed table, and priority tree represent different access patterns.

icons.title: Algorithm growth
icons.meaning: Logarithmic, linear, and quadratic operation counts diverge as input size increases.

icons.title: Boosted residual tree
icons.meaning: A shallow correction tree targets the remaining errors after an earlier prediction.

icons.title: Embedding metric geometry
icons.meaning: Vector angle and length make different similarity measures visible.

icons.title: Projection distance map
icons.meaning: Points in a plane cast onto a shorter coordinate axis with visible displacement.

icons.title: Grouped query head map
icons.meaning: Several query heads connect to fewer shared key and value heads.

icons.title: Image text alignment
icons.meaning: Image and text representations meet in a shared similarity space.

icons.title: Multimodal fusion bridge
icons.meaning: Image, sound, and text signals enter a shared representation path.

icons.title: Shared prefix block
icons.meaning: Two prompt lanes share a complete initial block before their tokens diverge.

icons.title: KV capacity budget
icons.meaning: Weights and working memory leave a limited region for active key and value state.

icons.title: Inference latency clocks
icons.meaning: A long initial processing segment is followed by repeated token intervals.

icons.title: Context window budget
icons.meaning: A finite window is divided among system, history, evidence, request, and output space.

icons.title: Context curation
icons.meaning: Many source records pass through selection and compression into a focused prompt.

icons.title: Edge model specialization
icons.meaning: A compact model on a local device is tuned to one focused task.

icons.title: Semantic cache gate
icons.meaning: A nearby question reaches a candidate answer that must pass three reuse checks.

icons.title: Model routing constraints
icons.meaning: A request passes hard policy checks before reaching eligible model lanes.

icons.title: GPU autoscale pool
icons.meaning: Queue pressure triggers new GPU replicas that become ready after warmup.

icons.title: Local model memory map
icons.meaning: Model weights and active state occupy separate device and host memory pools.

icons.title: Agent recovery state
icons.meaning: A timed-out action is verified before a safe retry or operator handoff.

icons.title: Persistent memory tiers
icons.meaning: Working context can write to and recall from several durable memory layers.

icons.title: Reasoning search tree
icons.meaning: Several partial solution paths are evaluated, pruned, and continued under a budget.

icons.title: Sandbox execution boundary
icons.meaning: Generated code runs inside a bounded workspace separated from secrets and network paths.

icons.title: GUI observe act loop
icons.meaning: A screen observation grounds a click, then the updated screen confirms the result.

icons.title: Tool protocol messages
icons.meaning: A host and server exchange correlated request and response messages through a client.

icons.title: Safety policy gate
icons.meaning: Input, action, and output checks protect different stages of a model interaction.

icons.title: Query expansion paths
icons.meaning: One question becomes several focused retrieval paths whose results are combined.

icons.title: Document segmentation
icons.meaning: A structured document becomes overlapping and section-aligned retrieval chunks.

icons.title: Evidence retrieval pipeline
icons.meaning: Versioned source evidence passes access filtering and ranking before it supports an answer.

icons.title: Training step loop
icons.meaning: A minibatch cycles through forward, loss, backward, and parameter update.

icons.title: Response token mask
icons.meaning: Prompt tokens remain contextual input while selected response tokens receive training loss.

icons.title: Prompt search loop
icons.meaning: Prompt candidates are scored on validation examples and then checked against a separate holdout.

icons.title: Recursive context tree
icons.meaning: A large source divides into bounded leaves and recombines through merge steps.

icons.title: Active learning frontier
icons.meaning: Uncertain examples near a model boundary are selected for human labeling.

icons.title: Fairness matched pairs
icons.meaning: Equivalent cases travel in parallel while one controlled attribute changes.

icons.title: Claim evidence link
icons.meaning: Answer claims connect to specific source spans, with unsupported claims left unlinked.

icons.title: Benchmark evidence gap
icons.meaning: A polished benchmark score is separated from a distinct production evaluation.

icons.title: CUDA grid block warps
icons.meaning: A grid contains thread blocks, each divided into groups of execution lanes.

icons.title: Precision scale accumulate
icons.meaning: Compact operands receive scaling before multiplication and wider-precision accumulation.

icons.title: Git history bisect
icons.meaning: Commit snapshots narrow a regression to the change that introduced it.

icons.title: Docker image layers
icons.meaning: An image assembles reusable base and application layers into a runnable container.

icons.title: Python data flow
icons.meaning: A keyed record becomes a batch of rows whose labels feed an explicit comparison.

icons.title: Apple unified memory
icons.meaning: CPU and GPU share physical system memory while a device change can still create a distinct buffer.

icons.title: SQL relational links
icons.meaning: Foreign keys connect rows across tables so a join can recover each chunk’s source.

icons.title: LLM API request
icons.meaning: An authenticated server turns a user task into a bounded provider request and records the result.

icons.title: AI app contract
icons.meaning: A request passes input validation and trusted-fact checks before an uncertain model answer can affect a decision.

icons.title: LLM lifecycle
icons.meaning: A model moves from pre-training through post-training, evaluation, compression and deployment.

icons.title: Forecast and alert
icons.meaning: A frozen forecast is compared with mature outcomes before an operational alert fires.

icons.title: ML release tuple
icons.meaning: A release binds data, features, model, policy, monitor and rollback artifact before promotion.

icons.title: Document evidence answer
icons.meaning: An approved passage supports an answer through a bound, auditable evidence receipt.

icons.title: Evaluation slices
icons.meaning: A suite-level score and per-slice results expose a safety failure hidden by an aggregate.

icons.title: Paired seed trial
icons.meaning: Each random seed runs both arms, so the comparison uses matched within-seed differences.

icons.title: GPT training loop
icons.meaning: A causal decoder predicts the next token, updates weights from loss and samples from the checkpoint.

icons.title: JAX transform pipeline
